newsitem.title: USA: Intermedia signs Panama access pact.
newsitem.headline: Intermedia signs Panama access pact.

text.p: Intermedia Communications Inc said Friday it had signed an exclusive, two-year agreement with Telecom Holdings Panama S.A. under which Telecom will operate a frame-relay service from Panama, using Intermedia as its primary distribution network.

The service is expected to begin generating revenues in this year's fourth quarter. Revenues are expected to grow to about $1 million annually during the first year and increase in subsequent years, the company said.
Intermedia will serve as the primary distribution network for the United States, Canadian and European frame-relay traffic originating in Panama.
